heroHeadline: Michigan Cases Reach 14,718 as CDC's Official Season Closes and Three States Stop Publishing Updates
heroSubtitle: Michigan's cyclosporiasis total climbs to 14,718 cases and 366 hospitalizations as of Sept 3 (up 208 from the prior week), interrupting weeks of slowing growth. Separately, food-safety attorney Bill Marler reports CDC's official May 1-Aug 31 surveillance season closed Sept 1 with 17,180 confirmed cases, 922 hospitalizations, 2 deaths, and a fifty-state combined tally of 32,857 — while flagging that Virginia, New York, and Ohio have already stopped publishing public case updates now that the season has ended. The narrower Taylor Farms/Taco Bell multistate outbreak remains at 11,458 confirmed illnesses across 20 states with 495 hospitalizations, unchanged since Aug 27.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
